BETA v1.9.3 (14 August 2019) |previous_update = [[BETA v1.8]] |next_update = [[BETA v1.10]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''BETA v1.9''' was the tenth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 9th of August 2019. This update is notable for bringing the [[Area 51 Event]], the second event in Tower Defense Simulator. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''BETA v1.9''' has been retroactively applied to this update. However, since this update also brought the [[Area 51 Event]], it can also be called, '''Area 51 Update'''. This version encompassed four updates, the main BETA v1.9.0 update (released 9 August 2019), and three minor updates, the BETA v1.9.1 (released 10 August 2019), the BETA v1.9.2 (released 13 August 2019) and the BETA v1.9.3 (released 14 August 2019). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Commando]] ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were added as part of the [[Area 51 Event]]. *[[Alien (Area 51)|Alien]] *[[Strong Alien]] *[[Lawnmower]] *[[Zoomer]] *[[Hidden Zoomer]] *[[UFO (Area 51)|UFO]] *[[Raider 1]] *[[Raider 2]] *[[Raider Boss]] ===Maps=== *[[Abyssal Trench]] (Survival) *[[Four Seasons]] (Survival) **Later removed in '''BETA v1.9.1''' *[[Space City]] (Survival) *[[Candy Valley (Versus)|Candy Valley]] ([[Versus]]) *[[Castle Outskirts]] ([[Versus]]) *[[Area 51]] ([[Area 51 Event]]) ===Emotes=== *[[Dream Feet]] ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Versus|Versus BETA]] *Badges for [[Doomspire]] and [[Crossroads]] :In '''BETA v1.9.1''': *Invisible part to the [[Versus]] [[Elevators|elevator]] so that you cannot fall into them ==Removals== :In '''BETA v1.9.1''': *[[Four Seasons]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Mannrobics]] music added. *Changed the description for [[Mannrobics]]. *Explosion sizes fixed. *Security fixes. *[[Turret]] default targeting changed from ''Closest'' to ''First''. :In '''BETA v1.9.1''': *Changing targeting now works in [[Versus]] mode. *Experimental data fixes implemented. *Reduced lag. *Fixed global leaderboards in the lobby. *Voting screen no longer stays on your screen forever if you join after voting has ended. *Moderation services are enabled again. *Towers now properly display in [[Versus]] mode. :In '''BETA v1.9.2''': *Fixed map not loading in Survival mode if the player character did not exist. *Fixed loading screens not initializing properly fixed. *Fixed tower selling/upgrading error that occured for some players. *Major data saving fixes. *Fixed enemies occasionally not spawning correctly, causing the game to break. *Fixed players not being placed on hteir correct team due to their character not being fully loaded. *Improved latency on both Survival and [[Versus]] modes. *[[Raider Boss]] health decreased from 40,000 to 35,000. *[[Swordmaster]] health decreased from 50,000 to 45,000. :In '''BETA v1.9.3''': *[[Gold Titan]] is no longer prone to errors. *[[Freezer]] is no longer prone to errors. *Minor improvements to [[Versus]] mode. *Fixed team teleportation issues. ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's update log on the devforum and the official Tower Defense Simulator discord. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===BETA v1.9.0=== *[[Area 51|AREA 51]] [EVENT] ([[Elevators#Event Elevators|Event elevator]] cycles between both events) *PVP BETA (Has specific PvP maps) *[[Commando]] (Stats will be changed in the future) *[[Dream Feet]] [TAUNT] (By. MRePotatoes) *[[Doomspire]] & [[Crossroads]] badges *[[Candy Valley (Versus)|Candy Valley]] & [[Castle Outskirts]] ([[Versus|PVP]] MAPS) :+[[Abyssal Trench]], [[Four Seasons]], [[Space City]] (SRV MAPS) :^Added music to [[Mannrobics]] taunt *Fixed explosion sizes (?) *Security fixes ===BETA v1.9.1=== *Added the invisible part again to the [[Versus|PVP]]/[[Versus]] [[Elevators|elevators]] so you cannot fall into them *Changing targeting mode on [[Versus|PVP]]/[[Versus]] works now *Improved lag on [[Versus|PVP]]/[[Versus]]/Classic *Experimental data fixes implemented *Fixed global leader boards in the lobby *If you load in late and voting has already finished, it will no longer stay on your screen *Experimental data fixes implemented *Moderation services enabled again *Fixed the issue with troops not properly displaying in [[Versus|PVP]]/[[Versus]] *Removed "Four Seasons" as it was causing multiple issues, will be added back within the upcoming week ===BETA v1.9.2=== *Fixed map not loading in Survival if the player character did not exist *Fixed loading screen not initializing properly *Fixed troop selling/upgrading error that occurred for some players *Major data saving fixes, after reviewing errors from our new logging system, we think we have solved the issue indefinitely *Fixed problem with enemies occasionally not spawning correctly, causing the game to break *Fixed problem with players not being placed on their correct team due to not their character not being fully loaded *Improved latency on both Survival and [[Versus|PVP]]/[[Versus]] ===BETA v1.9.3=== *[[Gold Titan]] is no longer prone to errors *[[Freezer]] is no longer prone to errors *[[Versus|PVP]]/[[Versus]] minor improvements *Fixed teleportation teaming issues {{UpdateNavBox}} [[Category:BETA Updates]]
